full_judgment:
(i)	A decree may be passed declaring the institution of preceding under Article 34 of the B. S. R. S. Order for auction sale of the plaintiff is illegal, fraudulent, malafide, motivated and void abinitio and not binding upon the plaintiff and defendant has no legal right or authority to proceed under Article 34 of the B. S. R. S. which has no application in the instant case. 

 (vii)	 By a decree of permanent injunction the defendant Nos. 1 & 2 to be restrained from proceeding further with their advertised sale of M/S. Delwar Coir Foam Industries Limited in terms of the paper publication dated 19th and 20th February, 1987. 

 (viii)	Cost of the suit be decreed against the defendants. 

 So it is apparent that no suit lies in respect or any sale under Article 34 and no injunction permanent or temporary can be granted in such case. The prayers made by the plaintiffs quoted above show that it prayed for declaring a proceeding under Article 34 of the said order as void. All other prayers are connected with the said prayer. In prayers (I), (IV) and (V), declaration of proceeding under Article 34 and the claim and calculation of the defendants to be void, illegal and fictitious are prayed for. In prayer No. VI declaration to the effect that the defendant has no right to claim any interest as there is no relation of lender and borrower between the defendant No.1 and the plaintiff prayed for. In prayer No. VII the plaintiff prays, for a decree of permanent injunction restraining the defendants from proceeding further with the proposed sale. All those prayers directly relate to action under Article 34. In prayer II and III although there is no mention about the proceeding under Article 34, those relate to the agreement and the personal guarantee in connection with the same transaction covered by Article 34. Hence all the prayers centre round the proceeding under the said article.
